correctness.rationale: The projective fixed-point equations give exactly six smooth points away from the unique singularity. The local action at the singularity admits an equivariant A-type normal form \(UV=z^{2n+2}\) with involution \((U,V,z)\mapsto(V,U,-z)\). Its toric resolution reverses the A-chain and fixes only the central component, where the induced Möbius involution has exactly two fixed points. The bundled checker verifies the finite algebraic consequences for every \(n=1,\ldots,8\). The total is therefore exactly eight, consistent with the independent general Nikulin theorem.

value.rationale: The source makes the symplectic involution explicit but leaves its Nikulin fixed set geometrically opaque in the canonical projective model. The localization explains uniformly how the abstract count eight is distributed between the visible genus-two ramification geometry and the resolution of the canonical ADE point. This is a natural structural datum for explicit quotient and branch calculations, not a routine restatement of the eight-point theorem.
